modalLead: Tags are easier to reach when adding or editing a bookmark, and building a collection now suggests values as you type.

items.text: Tags above the fold — in the quick-add bookmark modal (&) and the config bookmark form, the Tags field now sits right under Page/Category instead of hidden inside More options, so you can label a bookmark without expanding anything.
Clearer inline editor — the dashboard inline bookmark editor now orders its fields Page → Category → Tags → Note (with Note just above the Pinned/Status checks), matching the other bookmark forms.

Autocomplete in collection rules — when you add or edit a custom collection (Config → Collections), each rule's value field now suggests the tags, categories, and shortcuts already in use, the same way tags autocomplete on a bookmark. Shortcut suggestions keep their original casing (e.g. G, GI).

Snappier Back/Forward — the dashboard and config pages no longer opt out of the browser's back/forward cache, so returning to a page you just left is instant again while still loading the latest assets.
